title: QUIC RFC 9000 DATA_BLOCKED Frame Focused Proof Work Item
summary: Prove the RFC 9000 Section 19.12 DATA_BLOCKED frame type and Maximum Data field trace tail.
planned_changes:
- Add a focused DATA_BLOCKED requirement-home helper for exact field encodings, trailing-frame consumption, parser assertions, and formatter assertions.
- Add focused edge and negative proof for the DATA_BLOCKED type and Maximum Data variable-length integer field.
- Add direct focused proof that Maximum Data preserves the connection-level blocking limit, including the maximum 62-bit varint value.
- Add DATA_BLOCKED parse and format coverage to the existing QuicFrameCodec benchmark suite.
- Link the focused proof to dedicated architecture, work-item, and verification artifacts.
verification_plan: Run the focused S19P12 requirement-home filter, run a Release build, run the QuicFrameCodec benchmark Dry job, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, and check the diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: Adding public flow-control tuning or receive-window APIs.
Adding receiver autotuning behavior from DATA_BLOCKED feedback.
Replacing the span-backed frame-codec hot path.
completion_notes: Completed as focused parser/formatter, field-boundary, and benchmark proof over the existing DATA_BLOCKED frame codec seam.
